pluginMetaData.name: ASTM E1394 Data Type (bitdreamit)
pluginMetaData.author: Bit Dream IT
pluginMetaData.description: ASTM E1394-91/97 record-level parser/serializer (H/P/O/R/C/Q/M/L). Transport-agnostic; pairs with the ASTM E1381 transmission-mode plugin for full TCP/serial framing support. Includes header-delimiter derivation, escape sequence handling, batch splitting on H..L boundaries, configurable auto-responder, and response validation.
